U1.status: Development revision: standard 1.0 V core grade assumed; banks 0/14 = 1.8 V, CFGBVS = GND, bank 16 = 2.5 V, banks 15/34/35 = 1.5 V. There are 116 candidate FPGA connections, including provisional digital IMP_TST. AC_IN is a separate 0-1.5 V analog reservation with no FPGA GPIO. Detailed electrical limits, mating and timing remain unverified; MCU link implementation is deferred.
